title: A reader returns
summary: Begin with both clocks held. Single-step a sixteen-cell checker by changing phase, then single-step an eight-entry Boolean score with a visible playhead and a supplied click. Let each reader run independently. Preserve elapsed remainder, wrap addresses with modulo and declare the long-frame policy: advance past missed steps, sound only the final visit. Move one event without changing tempo, then change tempo without changing the score. Carry stable addresses, independently owned materials and the distinction between stored decisions and their readers into Colour.
short: Two held clocks. Phase → checker; Boolean score → playhead/click. Separate play/step. Keep time remainder. Stall: skip missed sounds, retain final index. No footstep recording. Carry record/reader into Colour.
object: A fixed checker, an eight-entry score and two independent clocks
carry: An arrangement keeps addresses while values and ways of reading them vary; material values can be assigned per instance in Colour.
